material_systems.name: Bare Drywall Prime — Standard PVA Drywall Primer
notes: Baseline system for new drywall porosity equalization.
QL-4 may still use this system depending on expectations and finish plan.

material_systems.name: Bare Drywall Prime — PVA Primer (QL-4 Discipline)
notes: Same primer strategy but expects more consistent backroll and defect correction discipline.

material_systems.name: Bare Drywall Prime — Higher-Build Primer Option
notes: Used when surface uniformity expectations are high or when finish plan demands more build.
May be paired with additional inspection and light sand after prime if fuzzing/defects appear.

coverage_profiles.profile_sensitivity_notes: Loss increases with spray, long hose purges, and active construction masking waste.
Slightly higher loss expected due to stricter application and rework.
Higher-build systems often lay heavier film and increase waste; refine with field logs.

usage_rate.notes: Higher nap may be chosen for primer; adjust later by wall/ceiling and texture plan.
Used for cut-in around edges where needed; may be reduced if spray-only and masked.
Represents average wear/filters for primer spray days; refine later.
Masking intensity increases if other trades present or if protection needs are higher.
Protection burden heavily depends on environment and staging.
Represents spot sanding + potential light sand after prime for fuzzing at higher tiers.
Primarily cleanup agents; actual chemistry depends on local VOC and product selection.

compatibility_rules.rule: If drywall dust is excessive, implement vacuum/wipe dust control prior to priming.
compatibility_rules.risk: Fuzzing, adhesion issues, and poor uniformity.
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Dust control task required; consider light sand after prime if fuzzing appears.

compatibility_rules.rule: If finish level is Level 5 expectation, primer strategy and inspection discipline must align.
compatibility_rules.risk: Joint banding and surface imperfections telegraph under final lighting.
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Use higher-build primer option and add inspection/correction rounds.

compatibility_rules.rule: In active construction environments, increase protection and coordinate with other trades.
compatibility_rules.risk: Overspray contamination and rework due to ongoing dust/traffic.
compatibility_rules.mitigation: Elevate protection module and consider staging areas and sequencing.

risk_notes: Active construction dust can undermine primer uniformity and increase rework.
Primer strategy selection should align with downstream finish systems.
assumptions: Spread rates and loss factors are placeholders for workflow demonstration; calibrate with field logs.
uncertainty_flags: Actual drywall finish quality may differ from declared level; inspection may reveal additional correction labor.
Spray productivity varies widely with masking and site layout.
